title: Lunga Park
intro: Marine Corps Base Quantico and Marine Corps Community Services have been working tirelessly over the past several years to rebuild and reopen this facility for you and your family's enjoyment. We are very proud of what has been accomplished here at Lunga Park and will continue the efforts to restore selected areas in the future.

sections.markdown:
Lunga Park is open 7 days a week, sunrise to sunset. Personal watercraft may launch sunrise to sunset with self check-in. Rentals are only available during Boathouse hours. Come and explore the beach volleyball area, General Store & Boat House, playground area, grills for family and unit cookouts, boat dock, pavilions, and onsite watercraft rentals. Also available, tent camping and rustic cabin rentals to make the outing a little easier! Pets are allowed but must remain on a leash. NO wading or swimming allowed at Lunga Park.

Per DoD policies, only authorized patrons (and guests) of MWR may be permitted access to Lunga Park in accordance with base access policies.

**The following individuals have full access to MWR services and programs:**

* Active-duty service members and their families
* Members of the National Guard and reserves and their families
* Current and retired DoD civilian employees
* Service academy and Merchant Marine cadets
* Retired service members and their families
* Honorably discharged veterans with a 100% service-connected disability
* Medal of Honor recipients
* Surviving family members of uniformed service members or retirees until they age out of eligibility or their dependent status associated with the deceased member or retiree changes

Please refer to the [MCBQ Visitor Control Center](https://www.quantico.marines.mil/Info/Base-Access/Visitor-Control-Center/) for any base access questions.

sections.heading: Go Play
sections.markdown:
* All rentals and reservations of picnic sites, pavilions, tent sites, cabin rentals, and the beach volleyball court will be conducted from the Lunga Boathouse on a first-come, first served basis.
* All rental gear such as watercraft, tents, coolers, camping and fishing gear will be conducted at the Boathouse and will follow the same pricing guidelines as the out-door recreation gear issue that the Marina has in place. Pricing is listed in the park information and fees brochures and flyers.
* Pets allowed but must be on a leash at all times.

For more information, check out our [FAQ's](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/modules/media/?do=inline&id=28621ab4-59dc-4498-8453-e58b9b9cca3a&v=1).

sections.heading: Go Camp
sections.markdown:
Camp Site Rentals:

* Tent Sites - $25 per night.
* Rustic Cabin - $40 per night (two nights minimum)

sections.heading: Go Fish
sections.markdown:
* All patrons wanting to fish should refer to MCINCR-MCBQO 11015.2D Fish and Wildlife Management Manual and regulations found at [https://quantico.isportsman.net](https://quantico.isportsman.net/).
* Bait will be available from the Lunga Park General Store during store operating hours.

**Fishing Hours of Operation**
(subject to change)

Monday-Sunday: 30 minutes before sunrise -- 30 minutes after sunset

For more information, check out our [FAQ's](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/modules/media/?do=inline&id=28621ab4-59dc-4498-8453-e58b9b9cca3a&v=1).

sections.heading: Go Boat
sections.markdown:
* All Virginia Boaters Safety rules apply to personally owned boats, see: [https://dwr.virginia.gov/boating/boaters-guide/](https://dwr.virginia.gov/boating/boaters-guide/)
* Virginia Requirements regarding Personal Flotation Devices (PFD) can be found at: [https://www.boat-ed.com/virginia/studyGuide/Specific-PFD-Requirements/10104702_49798/](https://www.boat-ed.com/virginia/studyGuide/Specific-PFD-Requirements/10104702_49798/)
* Patrons will be able to launch boats (with the exception of June 3) during launch operating hours only.
* Personally owned watercraft must obtain a launch pass from the Lunga Boathouse PRIOR TO LAUNCH.
* All boaters and paddlers must sign in to isportsman at **[https://quantico.isportsman.net](https://quantico.isportsman.net/)**.
* **No gas boating allowed.** Boats that have gas engines can be used, however, the engine must be raised and not utilized. If the boat has a removable fuel cell, the cell must be removed from the vessel prior to launching.
* **Personal watercraft (Jet Skis) or paddle boards are NOT PERMITTED in Lunga Reservoir.**
* No anchoring of any kind is allowed in Lunga Reservoir.
* No Swimming or Wading is allowed within Lunga Reservoir.
* Marina personnel have the right to refuse boat usage to anyone who, in their opinion, is not competent to sail, operate a powerboat, or who smells of alcohol or appears to be under the influence of alcohol or drugs. See MCBO 1700.2.
* No individual is to store, dispense, or consume alcoholic beverages in any buildings under the control of the Harbormaster. Patrons may consume beer only at the picnic areas. These restrictions do not apply to patrons on private boats.
* MCCS personnel, at their discretion, may at any time delay or cancel boat usage due to existing or projected inclement weather, i.e.. gusty winds, thunderstorms, or steady winds in excess of 16 knots.

**Boathouse Hours of Operation**
(subject to change)

Labor Day - Memorial Day: Monday-Sunday, 7:00am - 3:00pm

Memorial Day - Labor Day:
* Monday - Thursday: 7:00am - 3:00pm
* Friday - Sunday: 7:00am - 7:00pm

For more information, check out our [FAQ's](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/modules/media/?do=inline&id=28621ab4-59dc-4498-8453-e58b9b9cca3a&v=1).

sections.heading: Go Paddle
sections.markdown:
* MCCS rental watercraft will be issued from the Lunga Boathouse on a first-come, first served basis only. **Rentals are only available during Boathouse hours.**
* All MCCS powered watercraft will be operated by electric motor only by base order.
* Personal Flotations Devices (PFDs) must be worn at all times.
* Alcoholic beverages will not be permitted on MCCS watercraft at any time.
* No anchoring of any kind is allowed in Lunga Reservoir.
* No swimming or wading is allowed within Lunga Reservoir.
* MCCS personnel, at their discretion, may at any time delay or cancel boat usage due to existing or projected inclement weather, i.e.. gusty winds, thunderstorms, or steady winds in excess of 16 knots.
* Marina personnel have the right to refuse boat usage to anyone who, in their opinion, is not competent to sail, operate a powerboat, or who smells of alcohol or appears to be under the influence of alcohol or drugs. See MCBO 1700.2.
* No individual is to store, dispense, or consume alcoholic beverages in any buildings under the control of the Harbormaster. Patrons may consume beer only at the picnic areas. These restrictions do not apply to patrons on private boats.

**Boathouse Hours of Operation**
(subject to change)

Labor Day - Memorial Day: Monday-Sunday, 7:00am - 3:00pm

Memorial Day - Labor Day:
* Monday - Thursday: 7:00am - 3:00pm
* Friday - Sunday: 7:00am - 7:00pm

For more information, check out our [FAQ's](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/modules/media/?do=inline&id=28621ab4-59dc-4498-8453-e58b9b9cca3a&v=1).
